breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble about grid conventions, stating to use a point-based definition (dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)) which conflicted with the specific periodic grid definition required later (dx=(b-a)/Nx). The ground truth resolves this by removing the contradictory preamble. The agent successfully resolved this by ignoring the incorrect preamble and only including the correct, specific instruction for the periodic grid: 'Create uniform periodic grid with Nx = 1024 points on [0,1) using x_j = j*dx for j = 0,...,Nx-1 with dx = 1/Nx'.
